body.name: [H_{\mathcal E}]_{\mathrm{par}}
body.def: unit-row ambient encoders \(W\in\mathbb R^{n\times d}\) whose rows lie in \(\mathcal S\), whose fixed-coordinate row vectors satisfy \(U^{\top}W_{m,:}^{\top}\in\operatorname{col}(R_m)\), and whose latent-coordinate support is read in observed labels through \((WG)_{m,I(j)}\)
